item.title: Security incident
item.description:
Type: Incident
Affected Components: Builds, Networking, Addons, Logs and Metrics, Jobs, Services, Certificates Oct 31, 01:04:08 GMT+0 - Identified - We have enabled audit logs for all customers, including free users. Oct 30, 23:38:35 GMT+0 - Identified - Users have reported unauthorised use of AI API keys supplied to the Northflank platform.
If you have not already rotated your user-provided secrets stored in Northflank, please do so immediately. Revoke existing credentials with their issuing providers, generate replacements, and update the affected secrets and workloads in Northflank. Review your AI provider usage and billing logs for unexpected activity, and report any suspicious usage to Northflank support and the relevant provider.
These reports may be consistent with the broader pattern of attacks targeting AI credentials. Similar IP addresses are contained in this article [Wiz’s “Black October” report](https://www.wiz.io/blog/black-october-for-ai-developer-platforms). Oct 30, 19:28:55 GMT+0 - Identified - Our investigation is ongoing. We have no further confirmed findings to share at this time.
Our guidance remains unchanged: assume all environment variables have been compromised and rotate all secrets and credentials immediately, including those in workloads, secret groups and global secrets. Disable public access to addons where enabled.
We will share further updates as more information is confirmed. Oct 30, 15:12:25 GMT+0 - Identified - Secret rotation on Postgres and MongoDB has been enabled for all users. We recommend disabling public expose on addons if you have enabled that.
All users should assume their environment variables are decrypted and begin rotation immediately.
Secrets on workloads
Secret groups
Global secrets
Multiple users are confirming that their AI keys have been used. Oct 30, 13:58:15 GMT+0 - Identified - Assume all environment variables have been decrypted. Disable/rotate all keys. Oct 30, 13:40:03 GMT+0 - Investigating - Rotate environment variables immediately.

12:02 UTC: Initial network policy patch 12:50 UTC: Additional patching deployed
13:00 UTC: Wiz CIRT support requested
13:05 UTC: Additional patching deployed

item.title: Issues with Google Cloud platform - Affecting multiple services
item.description:
Type: Incident Duration: 2 hours and 45 minutes
Affected Components: Builds, Addons, Logs and Metrics Jun 12, 20:44:39 GMT+0 - Resolved - GCP BYOC cluster processing is now operational. Jun 12, 20:40:23 GMT+0 - Monitoring - We are observing improved operations in the US - Central region. Addon creation and backup issues are now resolved. Ongoing Issues: \* GCP BYOC cluster processing Jun 12, 19:21:45 GMT+0 - Monitoring - Google Cloud has acknowledged the incident. For detailed information, please visit: <https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/ow5i3PPK96RduMcb1SsW>
Most services have been restored to normal operation. However, we are still experiencing the following issues:
* Addon creation in the US - Central region * Addon backups in the US - Central region * GCP BYOC cluster processing
We will continue monitoring the situation and provide updates as they become available. Jun 12, 18:00:00 GMT+0 - Identified - We have noticed issues with Google Cloud APIs. This seems to be widespread across the Google Cloud platform. We are currently determining the impact of the outage, and we will provide updates when we know more. Currently, logs, metrics, builds, BYOC and addon backups may be affected.
